kyc.notFoundDescription: The link may be wrong, or the request does not exist.

decision.noteHelp: Required when rejecting or asking for more.

purgeNotice.Approve: All files will be deleted after the retention period (ID card and criminal record sooner); only the outcome is kept.
purgeNotice.Reject: All files will be deleted after the retention period (ID card and criminal record sooner); only the outcome is kept.

tutors.pageDescription: View and moderate the tutors on the platform.
tutors.heading: Tutors
tutors.subheading: Search, check status, suspend, reinstate and set a commission per tutor. Subjects are managed under "Subjects".
tutors.emptyDescription: Tutors appear here once they sign up.
tutors.headline: Headline
tutors.listedNote: Only the tutor turns this on or off; a suspension turns it off.
tutors.reliabilityNote: Worked out by the system from late cancellations and no-shows.
tutors.noStatusAction: Suspending or reinstating does not apply in this state.

suspend.title: Suspend this tutor
suspend.effect: {{name}} is hidden from search and loses access to teaching tools at once. Classes still to come are cancelled by the system and the learners refunded. The tutor will read your reason.
suspend.reasonHelp: The tutor will see this; it is also kept in the audit trail.

reinstate.title: Reinstate this tutor
reinstate.effect: {{name}} becomes a verified tutor again, but stays out of search until the tutor reopens themselves.

commission.title: Set this tutor's commission
commission.effect: Sets the commission rate used for {{name}}. The change is recorded with your reason.
commission.reasonHelp: Kept in the audit trail with the old and new rate.
commission.useDefault: Use the platform default (clear this tutor's rate)
commission.percentHelp: From {{min}} to {{max}}, at most two decimals.

subjects.pageDescription: Manage the subject groups and subjects tutors can teach.
subjects.heading: Subjects
subjects.subheading: Groups and their subjects. They cannot be deleted and the slug cannot change, but they can be switched off.
subjects.activateEffect: {{name}} can be chosen for new offerings again.
subjects.deactivateEffect: {{name}} can no longer be chosen, but offerings that already use it are left alone.
subjects.parentHelp: Pick the group a subject belongs to. Two levels at most.
subjects.parentLocked: A group that has subjects cannot move under another group.
subjects.slugHelp: Lower-case a-z, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
subjects.activeLabel: Active (can be chosen for new offerings)

validation.slug: Use lower-case a-z and digits joined by hyphens, at most {{max}} characters.

subjects.emptyDescription: Add the first subject so tutors can offer it.

disputes.pageDescription: Settle disputes between learners and tutors.
disputes.heading: Disputes
disputes.subheading: Cases raised by learners and tutors, most urgent first. The money of a disputed class is held until it is decided.

summary.heading: Queue summary
summary.failed: The summary could not be loaded; the list below still works.

filter.oneTutor: Showing one tutor only (press to clear)

disputes.emptyDescription: Disputes show up here when they are raised.
disputes.emptyFilteredDescription: Clear the filters or change the status.
disputes.takeOverEffect: You replace the administrator who currently holds this case.
disputes.staleReloaded: The latest version is loaded. Please check it again.

hint.minor_learner: The learner is a minor. Take extra care.
hint.behavior_complaint: A behaviour complaint, handled as high priority.
hint.repeat_complaint: This tutor has been complained about repeatedly in the last 90 days.
hint.learner_repeat_rejected: This learner has had several cases without a remedy.
hint.appeal_penalty_exists: The tutor was penalised for the no-show in this class.

message.heading: Write a message

effect.Internal: Only administrators see it. Nobody is notified.
effect.Parties: The learner and the tutor both read it and are e-mailed.

message.closed: This dispute is closed. You cannot write to the parties; internal notes are still possible.

outcome.heading: Outcome
outcome.alreadyDecided: This decision was already recorded; nothing was repeated.
outcome.noteSeenBy: The learner and the tutor see this in the app.

suspension.SkippedNotVerified: Not suspended: the tutor is not in the verified state.
suspension.Failed: Suspending the tutor failed. The decision stands; suspend from the tutor page.

outcome.followUp: The tutor must be compensated outside the system. Close this once it is done.

compensation.title: Close the compensation follow-up
compensation.effect: The system does not pay compensation itself. Confirm only after the tutor has been compensated outside the system.
compensation.noteHelp: Kept in the audit trail; the parties do not see it.

decide.title: Decide the dispute

flowHelp.Escrow: The money for this class is held. Choose whether to refund the learner or release it to the tutor.
flowHelp.AttendanceAppeal: The tutor is appealing the attendance result. No money is refunded.

Escrow.Reject: Reject the dispute (not valid, or abuse)

decide.figuresNote: The refund must be above 0 and no more than what is left (the price minus what was already refunded). The system checks it and tells you the maximum.
decide.overturned: Overturn the no-show (void the tutor's penalty)
decide.compensation: The tutor needs compensation outside the system (add to the follow-up list)
decide.noteHelp: A short reason both parties can understand.
decide.bothSeeNote: Both the learner and the tutor will read this.
decide.confirmIntro: You are deciding dispute {{no}}. Once recorded it cannot be changed.

effect.FullRefund: The learner is refunded the whole remaining amount of this class through Stripe (it can take days to arrive). The tutor receives nothing for this class.
effect.PartialRefund: The learner is refunded the amount you enter through Stripe. What remains on hold is released to the tutor right away.
effect.NoRefund: The learner is not refunded. The money on hold is released to the tutor right away.
effect.RejectEscrow: The dispute is closed as not valid. No refund; the held money is released to the tutor, and the case counts as rejected.
effect.packageCredit: This class was booked with a package credit; that credit is marked as refunded.
effect.tooLate: This class's money was already paid to the tutor. The refund is taken from the tutor's next earnings, which may leave a negative balance.
effect.ResolveAppeal: Appeal accepted: no money moves, and the appeal is recorded as accepted.
effect.RejectAppeal: The appeal is rejected. The attendance result and the tutor's penalty stay as they are. No money moves.
effect.overturn: The reliability penalty for this no-show is voided. The booking status does not change and the learner is not asked to give the money back.
effect.compensation: The case goes on the compensation follow-up list. The system pays nothing; you compensate the tutor yourself and then close it.
effect.suspend: The tutor is suspended after the decision is recorded (if they are verified at that point).
effect.bothSee: The learner and the tutor read your note and are told the result.

analytics.heading: Tutoring analytics
analytics.subheading: How the tutor marketplace is doing. Figures come from the server and may be a few minutes old; the time they were prepared is shown on every report.

range.order: The start must not be after the end.
range.future: The period cannot end after today.

tooLong.days: That period is too long: this report allows at most {{max}} days.

overview.heading: At a glance
overview.holdConversionHint: Of held bookings whose time to pay is over
overview.completionRateHint: Of paid lessons that have been decided
overview.retentionCohort: Learners whose first lesson was in {{month}}

revenue.heading: Revenue
revenue.description: Cash that moved and revenue the ledger recognised are two different measurements. They are shown apart and are not added together.
revenue.empty: There is no revenue activity in this period.
revenue.ledgerMismatch: The ledger totals do not match the payout totals for this period. Do not rely on these figures until the difference is explained.

notes.package_timing: Package money is collected when the package is bought, but the ledger recognises it when each lesson is booked, so the two do not match in the same period.
notes.ledger_excludes_fully_refunded_before_ba: A lesson that was fully refunded before it reached a payout batch is not in the ledger at all.
notes.fee_may_be_estimate: Recent payment fees can be estimates until the payment provider confirms them.
notes.cash_vs_ledger_not_comparable_per_bucket: Do not compare the two tables row by row: they use different dates.

cash.heading: Cash in and out
cash.description: Payments that succeeded and refunds that completed, by the day the money moved.
cash.caption: Cash collected and refunded for each period

ledger.heading: Revenue recognised in the ledger
ledger.description: What the platform ledger recorded after refunds, split into the platform commission and what is payable to tutors.
ledger.caption: Revenue recognised in the ledger for each period

search.heading: What people search for
search.description: The subjects searched most, and how often a search found no tutor at all.
search.hiddenHint: Subjects with fewer than {{min}} searches are not listed, to protect privacy
search.allHidden: Not enough data to list a subject: every subject was searched fewer than {{min}} times in this period.
search.startMoved: Search records are only kept for a limited time, so the period starts later than you asked.

retention.heading: Do learners come back?
retention.description: Learners are grouped by the month of their first completed lesson. For each group: how many booked another lesson within 30 and within 60 days.
retention.minCohort: A rate is only shown for a group of at least {{min}} learners.
retention.empty: No learner completed a first lesson in these months.
retention.caption: Learners who booked again, by the month of their first lesson
retention.footnote: A group is only counted once enough time has passed (30 or 60 days since the first lesson). A learner is the paying account, not each child.

funnel.heading: Booking funnel
funnel.description: Where the bookings made in the period ended up, by their state today.
funnel.empty: No bookings were made in this period.
funnel.barNote: Each bar is that count as a share of the bookings made in the period.
funnel.ratesNote: Each rate shows what it is out of. A rate with nothing to divide by reads "not enough data".

counts.cancelledByLearnerAfterConfirm: Cancelled by the learner after paying

tutors.ratingNote: Ranking by rating lists only tutors with enough reviews.
tutors.bookedNote: Booked value is the price of the completed lessons before commission and refunds. It is not what the tutor earned.
tutors.caption: Top tutors for the period
